name: [EXCHANGIFY]
label: Demo exchange
greeting: Hello. Ask about supported assets, fees, KYC limits or withdrawal times. I can also check a transaction with its reference and phone number.

received.label: Received
received.explanation: We have your transaction and it is waiting to be processed.

awaiting_confirmations.label: Awaiting network confirmations
awaiting_confirmations.explanation: The deposit is on the blockchain and we are waiting for the required number of network confirmations before crediting your balance.

processing.label: Processing
processing.explanation: Your transaction is being processed. No action is needed from you.

under_review.label: Under review
under_review.explanation: A compliance check is in progress. This is usually finished within 24 hours and needs no action from you unless we contact you.

completed.label: Completed
completed.explanation: This transaction is finished. The amount has been credited or paid out as requested.

failed.label: Failed
failed.explanation: This transaction did not complete. Any amount we received is refunded to the sending details on record; refunds are processed on business days.

refusals: no live rate quotes — live rates are shown in the app
